title: ReportProject
description: This schema defines the ReportProject entity. A `ReportProject` groups a set of saved queries against one or more services, run on a recurring schedule.

reportProjectType.description: Recurrence type of this report project.

reportQuery.description: A single saved query against a target service.

service.description: Fully qualified name of the service this query targets.

id.description: Unique identifier of this ReportProject instance.

name.description: A unique name that identifies this ReportProject.

queries.description: Saved queries belonging to this report project.

requestDeptKbCust.description: Department that requested this report project.

requestEmployeeKbCust.description: Employee who requested this report project.

itOwnerDeptKbCust.description: IT department responsible for this report project.

itOwnerEmployeeKbCust.description: IT employee responsible for this report project.

requestDateKbCust.description: Date the report project was requested (yyyy-MM-dd).

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.
